name: donordoc-01
description: DONORDOC-01 Website System. Sass source lives in scss/; css/style.css is generated output. js/ is source; js/app.min.js is generated output.

scripts.build:js: esbuild js/app.js --bundle --minify --sourcemap --format=iife --outfile=js/app.min.js && esbuild js/logo-boot.js --bundle --minify --sourcemap --format=esm --outfile=js/logo-boot.min.js && node scripts/version-assets.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
